LightningComponentBundle.description: Records audio, saves to the Contact's Files (FirstPublishLocationId), and outputs ContentDocument Id to a Screen Flow. Downstream steps can analyze the file and write JSON to Contact.Notes__c for de_final_screen.

property.name: recordId
property.label: Record ID (Contact)
property.description: Contact Id to attach the audio file to (Files). Use the same contact whose Notes__c field your flow updates after analysis.

property.name: contentDocumentId
property.label: Content Document ID
property.description: Id of the ContentDocument created in Files. Map this to a flow variable to use in later elements.
